class.name: PhysXFlowEmitter3D
class.brief_description: A placement marker for one [PhysXFlowSimulation3D] injection point, provided by the PhysX module.
class.description: A data-only node in the spirit of [CollisionShape3D]: it simulates nothing itself. List its path in [member PhysXFlowSimulation3D.emitters] and the simulation reads its properties every step; this node's global position is the emitter's world position. Channels mirror NVIDIA Flow's own emitter parameter blocks ([code]NvFlowEmitterSphereParams[/code] / [code]NvFlowEmitterBoxParams[/code]): [member velocity] pushes fluid, [member divergence] adds radial expansion, and the combustion trio ([member temperature], [member fuel], [member smoke]) feeds the solver's real combustion -- fuel above the layer's ignition temperature burns, producing heat (buoyant rise), extra smoke and light. A pure smoke emitter sets [member temperature] and [member fuel] to 0; a torch sets temperature + fuel and leaves smoke at 0 (combustion makes its own smoke).

members.member: How strongly the injected values blend toward their targets (Flow's per-channel coupleRate; the SDK default is 2).
Radial expansion injected around this node's position (explosion bursts).
Disables this emitter without removing it from [member PhysXFlowSimulation3D.emitters].
Injected unburnt fuel (consumed by combustion, producing heat and smoke).
[constant SHAPE_SPHERE] (uses [member radius]) or [constant SHAPE_BOX] (uses [member size], oriented by this node's transform).
Box full size in meters, halved internally ([constant SHAPE_BOX]).
Injected smoke density (the visible fog channel).
Injection substeps per solver step (smooths fast-moving emitters).
Injected temperature (drives buoyant rise; ignites fuel above the solver's ignition threshold).
Injection velocity in this node's local space (rotated by the node's orientation -- aim the node to aim the jet).

constants.constant: A box injection region oriented by this node's transform ([member size]).
